title.en: Omni Flash, Veo, and Nano Banana now billed per call
title.zh: Omni Flash、Veo、Nano Banana 改为按次计费

summary.en: These models switch from token-ratio display to a fixed per-call price on the Model Square.
summary.zh: 这些模型从按 token 倍率展示改为模型广场按次固定价。

body.en:
## Per-call pricing

Omni Flash, Veo 3.1, and Nano Banana are now **pay per call**, not token-ratio.

### Prices

- **Model IDs:** `nano_banana_2`, `nano_banana_pro` — **0.2 credits / call** ($0.02)
- **Model IDs:** `omni_flash-4s` — **0.2 credits / call** ($0.02)
- **Model IDs:** `omni_flash-6s` — **0.3 credits / call** ($0.03)
- **Model IDs:** `omni_flash`, `omni_flash-10s`, `veo_3_1` — **0.5 credits / call** ($0.05)
- **API:** image generations or video generations for the matching model
- **Display:** Model Square shows a single per-request price (no Input/Output 40 credits)

10 credits = 1 USD.
body.zh:
## 按次计费

Omni Flash、Veo 3.1、Nano Banana 现为**按次扣费**，不再按 token 倍率展示。

### 价格

- **模型 ID：** `nano_banana_2`、`nano_banana_pro` — **0.2 积分/次**（$0.02）
- **模型 ID：** `omni_flash-4s` — **0.2 积分/次**（$0.02）
- **模型 ID：** `omni_flash-6s` — **0.3 积分/次**（$0.03）
- **模型 ID：** `omni_flash`、`omni_flash-10s`、`veo_3_1` — **0.5 积分/次**（$0.05）
- **API：** 对应的图像或视频生成接口
- **展示：** 模型广场显示单次价（不再出现输入/输出 40 积分）

10 积分 = 1 USD。

summary.en: Public developer changelog for model launches and platform changes.
summary.zh: 面向开发者的公开更新时间线：模型上新与平台变更。

body.en:
## API Updates

OmniMux now publishes a dated **API Updates** feed so you can track gateway model launches and platform changes in one place.

### What we log

- **New models** — callable model IDs on live pricing
- **Model updates** — modes, durations, resolutions, parameters
- **Pricing** — material rate changes
- **Platform** — auth, domains, public HTTP surfaces

### How to call OmniMux

| Surface | URL |
| --- | --- |
| Console | `https://omnimux.ai` |
| OpenAI-compatible API | `https://api.omnimux.ai/v1` |
| Docs | `https://docs.omnimux.ai` |
| Status | `https://status.omnimux.ai` |

Auth for relay: Bearer `sk-…` from the console. Full catalog always lives on console pricing — this page is the **change timeline**.
body.zh:
## API 更新

OmniMux 现提供按日期排列的 **API 更新** 时间线，便于跟踪网关模型上新与平台变更。

### 记录范围

- **新模型** — 线上定价可调用的模型 ID
- **模型更新** — 模式、时长、分辨率、参数
- **价格调整** — 实质费率变化
- **平台** — 鉴权、域名、公开 HTTP 面

### 使用入口

| 面 | URL |
| --- | --- |
| 控制台 | `https://omnimux.ai` |
| OpenAI 兼容 API | `https://api.omnimux.ai/v1` |
| 文档 | `https://docs.omnimux.ai` |
| 状态页 | `https://status.omnimux.ai` |

Relay 鉴权：控制台签发的 Bearer `sk-…`。完整目录以控制台定价为准——本页是 **变更时间线**。

title.en: Social data models — TikTok, Instagram, X, YouTube
title.zh: 社交数据模型 — TikTok / Instagram / X / YouTube

summary.en: Read-only social data via Chat Completions-style model IDs.
summary.zh: 只读社交数据：Chat Completions 形态的模型 ID。

body.en:
## Social data (read-only)

**Social data** model IDs are available on OmniMux for read-only public profile and content style access. This is **not** social publishing.

### Model IDs

| Platform | IDs |
| --- | --- |
| TikTok | `tiktok-user`, `tiktok-posts`, `tiktok-video`, `tiktok-search` |
| Instagram | `instagram-user`, `instagram-posts`, `instagram-post`, `instagram-search` |
| X | `x-user`, `x-posts`, `x-tweet`, `x-search` |
| YouTube | `youtube-user`, `youtube-posts`, `youtube-video`, `youtube-search` |

### Publishing (different surface)

Connect accounts and create posts use **`/api/social/v1/*`** with access token + `New-Api-User`. Do not mix that auth with gateway `sk-` Chat Completions.
body.zh:
## 社交数据（只读）

**社交数据** 模型 ID 已在 OmniMux 可调用，用于只读的公开资料/内容类访问。**不是** 社媒发布。

### 模型 ID

| 平台 | ID |
| --- | --- |
| TikTok | `tiktok-user`、`tiktok-posts`、`tiktok-video`、`tiktok-search` |
| Instagram | `instagram-user`、`instagram-posts`、`instagram-post`、`instagram-search` |
| X | `x-user`、`x-posts`、`x-tweet`、`x-search` |
| YouTube | `youtube-user`、`youtube-posts`、`youtube-video`、`youtube-search` |

### 社媒发布（另一套面）

连接账户与发帖走 **`/api/social/v1/*`**，鉴权为 access token + `New-Api-User`。勿与网关 `sk-` Chat Completions 混用。

body.en:
## Seedance 2.5

**Seedance 2.5** is now available on OmniMux for async video generation.

### New model

- **Model ID:** `seedance-2-5`
- **Create:** `POST /v1/video/generations`
- **Poll:** `GET /v1/video/generations/{task_id}`
- **Highlights:** longer single-pass generation and multimodal reference inputs (text / image / video / audio style workflows)

Pin the exact ID from live pricing before integrating.
body.zh:
## Seedance 2.5

**Seedance 2.5** 现已在 OmniMux 可调用（异步视频生成）。

### 新模型

- **模型 ID：** `seedance-2-5`
- **创建：** `POST /v1/video/generations`
- **查询：** `GET /v1/video/generations/{task_id}`
- **要点：** 更长单次生成，支持多模态参考输入（文本 / 图像 / 视频 / 音频类工作流）

接入前请以线上定价的精确 ID 为准。
